user.title: Tesla EVTV BMS
user.description: Listen for LiteCAN UDP from the EVTV BMS. Entity prefix becomes sensor.<prefix>_<key> (must match the Sunny Island add-on pack_prefix). Cells in series: two Tesla modules = 12S. Optionally enable the SMA Sunny WebBox solar poller below.

data_description.entity_prefix: Must match Sunny Island pack_prefix (e.g. battery_storage_tesla_pack).
data_description.cells_in_series: Electrical series count, not total cells on the bus. 2×6S modules = 12.
data_description.webbox_host: IP or hostname only — no http://. Leave empty to disable WebBox solar sensors.
data_description.webbox_password: Only needed if WebBox JSON-RPC is enabled; home.ajax works without it.
data_description.webbox_scan_interval: How often to poll the WebBox (minimum 5 s).

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tesla EVTV BMS
reconfigure.description: Update pack settings or enable the SMA Sunny WebBox solar poller. UDP port cannot change here (it is the unique id).

data_description.webbox_host: IP or hostname only — no http://. Leave empty to disable WebBox solar sensors.
data_description.webbox_password: Only needed if WebBox JSON-RPC is enabled; home.ajax works without it.
data_description.webbox_scan_interval: How often to poll the WebBox (minimum 5 s).

abort.already_configured: A pack is already configured for this UDP port.

init.title: Tesla EVTV BMS options
init.description: Pack settings and optional SMA Sunny WebBox. Set WebBox IP to create sensor.*_webbox_power / daily_yield / total_yield.

data_description.cells_in_series: Electrical series count (2×6S modules = 12), not total cells on the CAN bus.
data_description.webbox_host: IP or hostname only — no http://. Clear the field and submit to disable WebBox.
data_description.webbox_password: Optional. home.ajax works without a password; RPC uses an MD5 hash of this value.
